operator_source: User-provided November 18, 2026 four proposals: SCDR, CRN morphogenesis, IPFC, LTM; uploaded memo. Research screen does not reproduce the full proposed algorithms.

outcomes.IPFC: On 64 uniformly independent Boolean rules, max prediction disagreement and exact 1-step EIG select identical 2-probe paths for all rules; 16 consistent rules remain; NOT a trial of learned falsifier coevolution or synthetic worlds.
outcomes.SCDR: Topological graph cycle rank =1 in a fully observed deterministic Markov 3-cycle with no hidden state (not a computed sheaf H1). A naive any-disagreement-on-100-pairs test under 5% iid noise has null FPR 0.999953777022. Exact binomial gate threshold16 gives 0.026535857831 null FPR and high contrast detection; not evidence against a formally defined cohomological algorithm.
outcomes.CRN: Three equally likely hidden context labels are unidentifiable without observations. A simple multiplicative affinity update equals Bayesian likelihood multiplication exactly; not a test of nonlinear mass-action network morphogenesis.
outcomes.LTM: 100 independently addressable bits, 20 changed, sparse direct edit 20 writes, 0 errors; not a test of stochastic thermal annealing, measured physical work or coupled causes.

limitations: No actual sheaf stalk/restriction/cohomology construction (graph Betti cycle merely refutes conflating cycles with hidden state)
No kinetic CRN ODE or composition-rewiring model instantiated; simple multiplicative proxy is Bayes
No co-evolved IPFC minimalist/falsifier neural or symbolic generator; only max disagreement score
No LTM energy-based model or physical Landauer measurement; local sparse update lower bound is fixture-specific
No model weights or native Yggdrasil checkpoints trained; no real transfer or retention gain
All tests source-free analytic synthetic toy screens, not original-science or protected first-use
Strong supervised recurrent, POMDP, modular neural router, EWC baselines remain required for future genuine Stage1
